'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Hello again. I was able to extract some scraps of information about a certain drug from the diary you brought. The owner of the diary used it frequently. It's some sort of combat stimulant, I think you might be interested in it. I can provide you with samples if you help me reproduce and test it. Here's a list of the items you'll need.}}

==Requirements==
* Unlocks 12-13 hours after completion of [[Thirsty - Echo]]

==Objectives==
* Hand over the 2 found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] items: [[Adrenaline injector]]
* Hand over the 4 found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] items: [[Bottle of OLOLO Multivitamins]]
* Hand over the 3 found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] items: [[Bottle of saline solution]]

==Rewards==
* +13,100 [[EXP]]
* [[Therapist]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.02'''</font>
* 6× [[2A2-(b-TG) stimulant injector]]  '''Note:''' Only obtainable by buyers of the "Edge of Darkness" edition of the game.
* Unlocks craft for [[2A2-(b-TG) stimulant injector]] at [[Hideout#Modules|Medstation level 2]]
{{quote|I was sure you'd be interested in this! Here are the results of the work.}}
